content:
1. The `runs.py` and `workspaces.py` routers still contain import statements for `require_role` from the deleted `bff.middleware.rbac` module, causing an ImportError at startup.

2. ```bash
# Fix bff/routers/runs.py: Remove the import line and any usage of require_role decorator if present
sed -i '/from bff.middleware.rbac import require_role/d' bff/routers/runs.py
grep -n 'require_role' bff/routers/runs.py | grep -v '^#' | while read line; do
  linenum=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f1)
  sed -i "${linenum}s/@require_role.*//g" bff/routers/runs.py
done

# Fix bff/routers/workspaces.py: Remove the import line and any usage of require_role decorator if present
sed -i '/from bff.middleware.rbac import require_role/d' bff/routers/workspaces.py
grep -n 'require_role' bff/routers/workspaces.py | grep -v '^#' | while read line; do
  linenum=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f1)
  sed -i "${linenum}s/@require_role.*//g" bff/routers/workspaces.py
done
```

3. `uvicorn bff.main:app_with_sio --port 8081`
